description:
`Nr5gRateMatchedDecoder::decode_iterative` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs` returns positions `0..target_k` of the decoded word as the message, while the encoder and `extract_message` use `systematic_cols[i]`. The two differ wherever the mother-code reduction swaps a systematic column below `target_k`. The defect is reported from reading the code and is unconfirmed by a failing test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test encodes and decodes through `decode_iterative` for a base graph and lifting size whose `systematic_cols` differ from the identity prefix, and the returned message equals the encoded message.
- [hard] REQ-02: `decode_iterative` and `extract_message` read the message through one shared mapping.
title: NR rate-matched iterative decoding reads the message from the first target_k positions
